<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z ≈ 100.052, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈ 99.045 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 5.5 % M+1) suggests five carbon atoms. A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C₅H₇O₂ (neutral mass 99.0444 Da, [M+H]⁺ = 100.0517 Da).</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
